Description: Susceptible humans exposed to malaria through infectious mosquito bites
Susceptible humans exposed to malaria through non-vector pathways
Loss of vaccine immunity, vaccinated humans return to susceptible class
Vaccinated humans exposed to malaria through infectious mosquito bites
Vaccinated humans exposed to malaria through non-vector pathways
Progression from non-vector exposed to infectious at rate τ2
Infectious humans receive treatment at rate σ
Treated humans recover at rate ω
Loss of immunity in recovered humans, relapse to susceptible class
Susceptible mosquitoes become exposed through contact with infectious humans
Exposed mosquitoes progress to infectious at rate φ

Name: π
Description: Human Population birth rate

Name: θ
Description: Rate of vaccine immunity loss due to vaccine failure

Name: ε
Description: Rate of Vaccine Efficacy

Name: ηV
Description: Effective contact rate of Human Vaccinated individuals with infected mosquitoes through bloodmeals

Name: ηS
Description: Effective contact rate of Human susceptible individuals with infected mosquitoes through bloodmeals

Name: ξV
Description: Effective contact rate of Human Vaccinated individuals with infected humans through other non-mosquitoes' ways (non-vector pathways) of malaria infectivity

Name: ξS
Description: Effective contact rate of Human susceptible individuals with infected human through other non-mosquitos' ways (non-vector pathways) of malaria infectivity

Name: τ1
Description: Human Population Progression rate from exposed to infectious for mosquitos' malaria exposed individuals

Name: τ2
Description: Human Population Progression rate from exposed to infectious for non-mosquitos' (non-vector pathways) malaria exposed individuals

Name: δ1
Description: Human Population Malaria disease death rate

Name: σ
Description: Human Population progression rate from infected to treated

Name: ω
Description: Human Population progression rate from treated to recovered

Name: γ
Description: Human recovered Population rate of immunity loss

Name: ρ
Description: Effective contact rate of susceptible mosquitoes with infected humans through bloodmeals

Name: φ
Description: Mosquitoes Population Progression rate from exposed to infectious

Name: β1
Description: Active contact rate of vaccinated humans with infectious vector, defined as β1 = ηV * IM

Name: β2
Description: Active contact rate of susceptible humans with infectious vector, defined as β2 = ηS * IM

Name: α1
Description: Active contact rate of vaccinated humans with infectious non-vector ways, defined as α1 = ξV * IH

Name: α2
Description: Active contact rate of susceptible humans with infectious non-vector ways, defined as α2 = ξS * IH

Name: β3
Description: Effective contact rate of susceptible mosquitoes with infected humans, defined as β3 = ρ * IH

Name: R0
Description: Basic reproduction number of the malaria model, computed via next generation method

Name: R01
Description: Component of R0 related to non-vector transmission: R01 = ξS * π * τ2 / [µ1 * (µ1+τ2) * (µ1+δ1+σ)]

Name: R02
Description: Component of R0 related to vector-borne transmission (human to mosquito side): R02 = ηS * π * τ1 / [µ1 * (µ1+τ1) * (µ1+δ1+σ)]

Name: R03
Description: Component of R0 related to vector-borne transmission (mosquito side): R03 = ρ * Λ * φ / [µ2^2 * (µ2+φ)]
